image_description: A low-angle shot of a large pipe organ situated within an ornate, organic-style architectural interior (resembling Gaudí's Sagrada Família). The organ features multiple groups of vertical metallic pipes of varying heights, arranged symmetrically around a central taller cluster. The pipes have a reflective blue-grey metallic finish. The surrounding architecture includes branching, tree-like stone columns and stained glass windows that cast colored light onto the scene. The console area is dark and largely obscured by shadow at the bottom.
